    FROM sales_2009 s

    FROM sales_2009

        b.ProductKey AS product_key_b,
        uniqExact(a.SalesOrderNumber) AS common_orders
    FROM order_products a
    INNER JOIN order_products b

WITH store_day AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        DateKey,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS sales
    FROM retail.FactSales
    GROUP BY StoreKey, DateKey
),
outage_day AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        DateKey,
        count()          AS outage_cnt,
        sum(DownTime)    AS downtime
    FROM retail.FactITSLA
    GROUP BY StoreKey, DateKey
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        sd.StoreKey                                   AS store_key,
        sd.DateKey                                    AS day,
        sd.sales                                      AS sales,
        if(o.outage_cnt > 0, 1, 0)                    AS has_outage,
        o.downtime                                    AS downtime
    FROM store_day AS sd
    LEFT JOIN outage_day AS o
        ON sd.StoreKey = o.StoreKey
       AND sd.DateKey  = o.DateKey
)
SELECT
    if(has_outage = 1, '有故障的门店日', '无故障的门店日')                    AS `分组`,
    count()                                                                 AS `门店日数`,
    round(sum(sales), 2)                                                    AS `销售额合计`,
    round(avg(sales), 2)                                                    AS `日均销售额`,
    round(avg(downtime), 2)                                                 AS `平均停机时长分钟`,
    if(max(downtime) > 0, round(corr(sales, downtime), 4), NULL)            AS `停机时长与日销售额相关系数`
FROM joined
GROUP BY has_outage
ORDER BY has_outage DESC

WITH rev AS (

           sum(f.Amount) AS amt
    FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan AS f

anc AS (

    WHERE s.EntityType = 'Store'
),
nodes AS (

    SELECT store_key, l2 FROM anc WHERE l2 > 0

WITH store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ds.EntityKey AS entity_key,
        sum(fs.SalesAmount) AS revenue
    FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
    INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS ds ON fs.StoreKey = ds.StoreKey
    GROUP BY ds.EntityKey
),
entity_tree AS (
    SELECT
        s.EntityKey AS store_key,
        s.EntityName AS store_name,
        if(p1.EntityType = 'State', p1.EntityKey, 0) AS state_key,
        if(p1.EntityType = 'State', p1.EntityName, '') AS state_name,
        if(
            p1.EntityType = 'State', p2.EntityKey,
            if(p1.EntityType = 'Country/Region', p1.EntityKey, 0)
        ) AS country_key,
        if(
            p1.EntityType = 'State', p2.EntityName,
            if(p1.EntityType = 'Country/Region', p1.EntityName, '')
        ) AS country_name,
        if(
            p1.EntityType = 'State', p3.EntityKey,
            if(p1.EntityType = 'Country/Region', p2.EntityKey, 0)
        ) AS group_key,
        if(
            p1.EntityType = 'State', p3.EntityName,
            if(p1.EntityType = 'Country/Region', p2.EntityName, '')
        ) AS group_name
    FROM retail.DimEntity AS s
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimEntity AS p1 ON s.ParentEntityKey = p1.EntityKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimEntity AS p2 ON p1.ParentEntityKey = p2.EntityKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimEntity AS p3 ON p2.ParentEntityKey = p3.EntityKey
    WHERE s.EntityType = 'Store'
)
SELECT level, entity_name, revenue
FROM (
    SELECT 'Store' AS level, t.store_name AS entity_name, sum(ss.revenue) AS revenue
    FROM entity_tree AS t
    INNER JOIN store_sales AS ss ON t.store_key = ss.entity_key
    GROUP BY t.store_key, t.store_name

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'State' AS level, t.state_name AS entity_name, sum(ss.revenue) AS revenue
    FROM entity_tree AS t
    INNER JOIN store_sales AS ss ON t.store_key = ss.entity_key
    WHERE t.state_key > 0
    GROUP BY t.state_key, t.state_name

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'Country/Region' AS level, t.country_name AS entity_name, sum(ss.revenue) AS revenue
    FROM entity_tree AS t
    INNER JOIN store_sales AS ss ON t.store_key = ss.entity_key
    WHERE t.country_key > 0
    GROUP BY t.country_key, t.country_name

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'Group' AS level, t.group_name AS entity_name, sum(ss.revenue) AS revenue
    FROM entity_tree AS t
    INNER JOIN store_sales AS ss ON t.store_key = ss.entity_key
    WHERE t.group_key > 0
    GROUP BY t.group_key, t.group_name
)
ORDER BY
    multiIf(level = 'Group', 1, level = 'Country/Region', 2, level = 'State', 3, 4),

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        toYear(f.DateKey) AS year,
        if(c.ProductCategoryName = '', '未知产品', c.ProductCategoryName) AS category,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS sales_amount,
        sum(f.TotalCost) AS total_cost,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) - sum(f.TotalCost) AS gross_profit,
        (sum(f.SalesAmount) - sum(f.TotalCost)) / nullIf(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0) AS gross_margin
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS s
        ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = s.ProductSubcategoryKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS c
        ON s.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) IN (2007, 2008, 2009)
    GROUP BY year, category
), with_change AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        category,
        sales_amount,
        gross_profit,
        gross_margin,
        lagInFrame(gross_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY year) AS prev_margin
    FROM yearly
)
SELECT
    year AS `年份`,
    category AS `产品品类`,
    sales_amount AS `销售金额`,
    gross_profit AS `毛利`,
    round(gross_margin * 100, 2) AS `毛利率_百分比`,
    if(year = 2007, NULL, round((gross_margin - prev_margin) * 100, 2)) AS `毛利率较上年变化_百分点`
FROM with_change
ORDER BY category, year

WITH lvl AS (
    SELECT
        `名义折扣率`                                   AS d,
        uniqExact(`订单日期`)                          AS days,
        sum(`销售数量`)                                AS qty,
        sum(`销售金额`)                                AS amt,
        sum(`折扣金额`)                                AS disc,
        sum(`折扣前原价`)                              AS gross
    FROM dwd.wide_online_sales
    WHERE `是否打折` = 1
    GROUP BY `名义折扣率`
),
calc AS (
    SELECT
        d, days, qty, amt, disc, gross,
        qty / days                                     AS dq,
        lagInFrame(qty / days) OVER (ORDER BY d)       AS prev_dq,
        lagInFrame(d)          OVER (ORDER BY d)       AS prev_d
    FROM lvl
)
SELECT
    d                                                                 AS `名义折扣率`,
    days                                                              AS `有销售天数`,
    qty                                                               AS `销量`,
    round(dq, 2)                                                      AS `日均销量`,
    round(amt, 2)                                                     AS `销售额`,
    round(disc / nullIf(gross, 0), 4)                                 AS `实际折扣率`,
    round(dq / nullIf(prev_dq, 0) - 1, 4)                             AS `日均销量较上一档变化率`,
    round(
        ((dq - prev_dq) / nullIf((dq + prev_dq) / 2, 0))
        / nullIf((d - prev_d) / nullIf((d + prev_d) / 2, 0), 0)
    , 4)                                                              AS `价格弧弹性（%Δ销量÷%Δ折扣率）`
FROM calc
ORDER BY d

WITH tier AS (
    SELECT
        p.DiscountPercent                        AS disc,
        sum(f.SalesQuantity)                     AS qty,
        sum(f.SalesAmount)                       AS rev,
        sum(f.DiscountAmount)                    AS disc_amt,
        uniqExact(f.DateKey)                     AS days,
        count()                                  AS order_lines,
        uniqExact(f.SalesOrderNumber)            AS orders
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimPromotion AS p
        ON f.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
    GROUP BY p.DiscountPercent
),
base AS (
    SELECT qty, rev, days, disc_amt, orders
    FROM tier
    WHERE disc = 0
)
SELECT
    tier.disc                                                              AS `名义折扣率`,
    round(tier.disc_amt / nullIf(tier.rev + tier.disc_amt, 0), 4)          AS `实际折扣率`,
    tier.orders                                                            AS `订单数`,
    tier.order_lines                                                       AS `订单行数`,
    tier.days                                                              AS `有销售天数`,
    round(tier.qty / tier.days, 1)                                         AS `日均销量`,
    round(tier.rev / tier.days, 2)                                         AS `日均销售额`,
    round(tier.rev / nullIf(tier.qty, 0), 2)                               AS `平均成交单价`,
    round((tier.qty / tier.days) / nullIf(base.qty / base.days, 0) - 1, 4) AS `日均销量变化率`,
    round((tier.rev / tier.qty) / nullIf(base.rev / base.qty, 0) - 1, 4)   AS `平均单价变化率`,
    round(
        ((tier.qty / tier.days) / nullIf(base.qty / base.days, 0) - 1)
        / nullIf((tier.rev / tier.qty) / nullIf(base.rev / base.qty, 0) - 1, 0)
    , 3)                                                                   AS `价格弹性`
FROM tier
CROSS JOIN base
ORDER BY tier.disc

WITH store_q AS (

    StoreName AS `门店`,

    q4_sales AS `2009Q4销售额`,
    q4_sales - q3_sales AS `Q4较Q3变化额`,
    (q4_sales - q3_sales) / nullIf(q3_sales, 0) AS `Q4较Q3变化率`

WITH daily AS (

    GROUP BY day, category, day_type

        countIf(day_type = 'WorkDay') AS weekday_days
    FROM daily
    GROUP BY category
)

    round(weekend_avg, 2) AS `周末日均销售额`,
    round(weekday_avg, 2) AS `工作日日均销售额`,
    round(weekend_avg - weekday_avg, 2) AS `周末较工作日差额`,
    round(if(weekday_avg = 0, NULL, (weekend_avg - weekday_avg) / weekday_avg * 100), 2) AS `周末较工作日差额百分比`,
    weekend_days AS `周末有销售天数`,
    weekday_days AS `工作日有销售天数`
FROM agg
ORDER BY `品类`
